select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/
d.busi_type busiTypeCode, /**业务类型Code**/ d.busi_type busiType, /**业务类型**/

select distinct d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, zc.FINPROD_ID as assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr,/**资产简称**/ d.PS as psCode,/**交易方向Code**/ d.PS as ps,/**交易方向**/ nvl(d.SHARE_AMT, 0) as shareAmt,/**交易份额**/ nvl(d.FEE_AMT, 0) as feeAmt, /**交易费用**/ nvl(d.TRADE_AMT, 0) as tradeAmt, /**交易金额**/ to_char(d.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as bookDate,/**入账日(交易日)**/ d.CCY as ccyCode,/**交易币种Code**/ d.CCY as ccy,/**交易币种**/
( CASE WHEN instr('C1,T04,T11,T12,T20,T21,C3,C6', d.ps) >0 THEN to_char(d.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') ELSE NULL END ) as tradeDate, /**交易日**/ ( CASE WHEN instr('T18,T05,T19', d.ps) >0 THEN to_char(d.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') ELSE NULL END ) as confirmDate, /**确认日**/ nvl(DECODE(d.PS,'T18',d.INT_AMT), 0) AS intAmt,/**利息金额(利息总额)**/ DECODE(d.PS,'T19',to_char(d.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd'))AS settleDate,/**预计到账日(交割日)**/ nvl(DECODE(d.PS,'T11',d.TRADE_AMT), 0) AS cashAmt,/**现金分红金额（交易金额）**/ nvl(DECODE(d.PS,'T12', d.Prin_Amt), 0) AS bonusAmt,/**红利再投金额（交易金额）**/ nvl(DECODE(d.PS,'T12',d.SHARE_AMT), 0) AS bonusShare,/**红利再投份额（交易份额）**/
( CASE WHEN instr('T12,T06,T19,T24', d.PS) >0 THEN d.INT_AMT ELSE 0 END ) as bAmt,/**应收红利（应收利息）**/ nvl(DECODE(d.PS,'T12', d.Prin_Amt), 0) AS realAmt,/**实收红利（交易金额）**/ DECODE(d.PS,'T19',to_char(d.cprice_Date,'yyyy-mm-dd'))AS cpriceDate,/*净值日*/ nvl(DECODE(d.PS,'T19',d.UNIT_CPRICE), 0) AS unitCprice,/**赎回净值（单位净价）**/ DECODE(d.PS,'T24',to_char(stl.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd'))AS realDate,/**实际到账日（结算日）**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, /**业务类型Code**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType /**业务类型**/ from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d inner join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' left join STL_ORDERS stl on stl.TRADE_ID = d.TRADE_ID and d.PS = 'T24' /**结算指令表**/
where
1=1
and zc.finprod_type != 'F17'
and d.TRADE_ID LIKE '%'||#{paTradeId}||'%'
and (zc.FINPROD_ID LIKE '%'||#{paAsset}||'%' or zc.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE '%'||#{paAsset}||'%' ) and d.BUSI_TYPE in
#{queryType}
and d.BUSI_TYPE in
#{paBusiType}
and book.BOOKSET_ID in
#{bookSetId}
and d.PS in
#{paPs}
and d.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and d.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and zc.profit_type=#{profitType}

select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId,/**交易编号**/
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType,/**回购类型-业务类型**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, /**业务类型Code**/ d.finprod_type as finprodTypeCode,/**回购方向Code - 产品类型**/ d.finprod_type as finprodType,/**回购方向 - 产品类型**/ d.PS as psCode,/**交易方向Code**/ d.PS as ps,/**交易方向**/ d.COUNTER_ID as counterId,/**交易对手**/
d.ccy as ccyCode, /**币种Code**/ d.ccy as ccy, /**币种**/ to_char(d.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as tradeDate,/**发生日 - 取交易日期**/ to_char(d.vdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') as vDate,/**起息日**/ to_char(d.mdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') as mDate,/*到期日*/ ftp.TERM_TYPE as termType, /** 期限品种**/ ftp.INT_RATE*100 as intRate, /** 回购利率(%) - 固定利率**/ d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, /** 交易金额 **/ d.CHL_ID as chlId,/**通道**/ d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatusCode, /**交易状态Code**/ d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatus, /**交易状态**/ /**(CASE WHEN instr(';T07', d.ps) >0 THEN d.PRIN_AMT ELSE 0 END) as prinAmt, 交易本金 **/ d.PRIN_AMT as prinAmt, /**交易本金 **/ /**(CASE WHEN instr(';T07', d.ps) >0 THEN d.PRIN_AMT ELSE 0 END) as firSetAmt,首次结算金额**/ d.PRIN_AMT as firSetAmt,/**首次结算金额**/ /**(CASE WHEN instr(';T07', d.ps) >0 THEN d.prin_amt/ftp.prin*ftp.m_trade_amt ELSE 0 END) as expSetAmt, 到期结算金额**/ d.prin_amt/ftp.prin*ftp.m_trade_amt as expSetAmt, /**到期结算金额**/ /**(CASE WHEN instr(';T07', d.ps) >0 THEN d.prin_amt/ftp.prin*ftp.m_int_amt ELSE 0 END) as intAmt, 应计利息 - 利息总额 **/ d.prin_amt/ftp.prin*ftp.m_int_amt as intAmt, /**应计利息 - 利息总额 **/ ( CASE WHEN instr('T20,T25;T21,T26', d.ps) >0 THEN d.INT_AMT ELSE 0 END ) as tranAmt,/**转入/转出利息金额**/ ( CASE WHEN instr('T27', d.ps) >0 THEN d.INT_AMT ELSE 0 END ) as divAmt/**派息金额**/, d.fee_amt_pay as feeAmtPay, /*随交易支付费用*/ d.fee_amt_unpay as feeAmtUnpay /*不随交易支付费用*/ from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO cust_out on cust_out.customer_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_PRODUCT cust_in on cust_in.finprod_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp on ftp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and d.branch=ftp.branch and (ftp.branch_type is null and ftp.branch = '0') /**只统计接口接进来的标的信息，不统计插入该表的交易信息**/ where 1=1
and d.TRADE_ID LIKE '%'||#{paTradeId}||'%'
and d.TRADE_ID LIKE '%'||#{paAsset}||'%' and d.BUSI_TYPE in
#{queryType}
and d.BUSI_TYPE in
#{paBusiType}
and book.BOOKSET_ID in
#{bookSetId}
and d.PS in
#{paPs}
and d.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and d.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and cp.profit_type=#{profitType}
